items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: I know Buckley played a lot of people.

ctx.x: The trumpet players say it hurts their tone to play rock and roll.

Yeah, most of all the rock and roll is just about under tenors on the record. You hear it. And it seems like the worst they play is a better sound. People are. Well we're getting paid for it. Nothing wrong. I can't cut it, we're getting paid for it. But I don't think it's proper as it used to be. I think it's raining. I don't know. Well there's a little of this old town Dixieland. Yeah, that's something about Dixie. A lot of people ask for it. Because some guy used to go out in a concert spot. I know Buckley…
I know Buckley played a lot of people. I know Buckley played a lot of people.
